Job Description
JOB DESCRIPTION
Department: Process
Job Title: Process/Technical Engineer-Technical Contract Review (Bilingual Chinese and English)
JOB PURPOSE
The purpose of this position is to Lead technical reviews of customer contracts and technical agreements, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), manufacturing process requirements, and customer-specific technical specifica...tions, ensure contract reviews are completed accurately and on time to minimize execution risks, quality issues, and compliance concerns, and provide on-site technical support to manufacturing and resolve engineering or process-related issues during contract implementation.
JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead technical reviews of customer contracts and technical agreements for regional sales orders, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), manufacturing process requirements, customer-specific technical specifications, and special contractual requirements.
• Ensure contract reviews are completed accurately and on time to minimize execution risks, quality issues, and manufacturing nonconformities.
• Provide technical support to production during contract implementation and resolve engineering and process-related issues to ensure successful execution. Contract Review Process & Documentation
• Participate in the development, validation, implementation, and promotion of cost reduction initiatives, including alternative material qualification, process optimization, and product design simplification.
• Drive the implementation and utilization of approved cost-saving materials within the assigned region to support the company's overall cost reduction strategy and business objectives.
• Collaborate with Sales, R&D, Purchasing, Production, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to coordinate contract review activities and cost reduction initiatives.
• Identify and proactively mitigate key quality risks throughout the photovoltaic module product lifecycle, with a focus on materials, manufacturing processes, and product reliability.
• Perform other engineering duties and responsibilities as assigned.
REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical/Materials Engineering or related discipline required (Master’s degree preferred).
• Bilingual in Mandarin Chinese and English preferred.
• 1-3 years of working experience in high-tech manufacturing industry or highly automated manufacturing environment.
• Experience with engineering change management (ECN), BOM management, and manufacturing documentation is preferred.
• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, customer requirements, and manufacturing documentation.
• Familiarity with photovoltaic module manufacturing processes, materials, and engineering change processes.
• Computer skills including Microsoft Office and CAD software (Solidworks or Inventor), experience using SAP, PLM and MES.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate manufacturing feasibility, identify technical risks, and support engineering decisions.
• Strong cross-functional communication and project coordination skills.
• Willingness to support cross-functional engineering activities, including contract review, production support, cost reduction initiatives, process improvement, and other engineering projects.
• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
• Ability to stand and walk the production area throughout the workday. Able to lift to 50 pounds without restriction.
PLACE OF JOB IN THE ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE
Reports to Process Superintendent

title: Warehouse Operations Engineer
description:
Department:
Warehouse
Job Title:
Warehouse Operations Engineer
Overview:
The Warehouse Operations Engineer supports warehouse operations within Jax Power's solar manufacturing facility. This role focuses on inventory accuracy, efficient material flow, process improvement, and coordination with production and supply chain teams. The position supports the receiving, storage, movement, and shipment... of raw materials, production components, spare parts, packaging materials, and finished products.
Job Duties & Responsibilities:
• Ensure warehouse activities comply with company safety policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Support receiving, unloading, inspection, put-away, storage, picking, packing, staging, shipping, and production material replenishment.
• Coordinate the timely movement of materials to prevent shortages, delays, and production interruptions.
• Maintain accurate inventory records through timely ERP and Warehouse Management System transactions.
• Conduct cycle counts, physical inventories, reconciliations, and discrepancy investigations.
• Ensure materials are properly identified, labeled, stored, handled, and traceable.
• Monitor warehouse workflows, space utilization, inventory movement, and operational performance to identify improvement opportunities.
• Investigate inventory and process issues, determine root causes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
• Implement improvements that enhance safety, productivity, inventory accuracy, quality, and material flow.
• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, work instructions, process flows, and training materials.
• Track warehouse performance indicators and prepare reports for management.
• Coordinate with Quality regarding damaged, rejected, quarantined, returned, or nonconforming materials.
• Collaborate with Production, Planning, Logistics, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.
• Support warehouse layout planning, storage optimization, employee training, onboarding, audits, and safety inspections.
• Perform other warehouse operations and process-improvement duties as assigned.
Key Requirements & Competencies:
• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field is required.
• Zero to three years of experience in warehouse operations, manufacturing, logistics, inventory control, or supply chain is preferred.
• Experience in solar, electronics, automotive, battery, or high-volume manufacturing is preferred.
• Working knowledge of ERP and Warehouse Management Systems is preferred.
• Knowledge of inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, cycle counting, and material traceability.
• Familiarity with root-cause analysis, corrective actions, 5S, Lean manufacturing, and process standardization is preferred.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate operational records.
• Ability to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
• Ability to work effectively with warehouse employees, supervisors, engineers, and cross-functional teams.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.
• Bilingual proficiency in Mandarin and English is strongly preferred.
Physical Requirements:
• Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform warehouse-related activities throughout an eight-hour or longer shift, as required.
• Ability to work in a warehouse and manufacturing environment with exposure to varying temperatures, noise, dust, machinery, and forklift traffic.
• Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or move materials weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Ability to climb stairs, access storage locations, and perform physical inventory-verification activities.
• Ability to wear required personal protective equipment in designated areas.
Place of Job in the Organizational Structure:
The Warehouse Operations Engineer reports directly to the Warehouse Manager and works closely with Warehouse, Production, Planning, Logistics, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.

Job Title:
Production Planning Specialist / PMC Coordinator
Overview:
The Production Planning Specialist... / PMC Coordinator supports production scheduling, sales order alignment, cell and power allocation, material and BOM readiness, rework planning, inventory follow-up, and cross-functional coordination. This role helps ensure that customer demand, production capacity, material availability, actual output, finished goods inventory, and shipment plans are properly aligned while reducing shortages, overproduction, obsolete inventory, and delivery risks.
Job Duties & Responsibilities:
• Assist in maintaining production schedules based on sales orders, Goods Ready Dates, capacity, material status, and shipment priorities.
• Follow production orders through completion and support timely order fulfillment.
• Track cell efficiency, module power output, and sales order wattage requirements to support proper cell and customer demand matching.
• Identify and escalate risks related to power shortage, high-efficiency cell usage, order structure mismatch, and output-versus-demand gaps.
• Coordinate with Sales and Planning teams regarding demand adjustments and order risks.
• Verify readiness of key materials, including glass, frame, EVA/POE, junction box, silicone, labels, and packaging.
• Review BOM readiness and identify potential changeover risks.
• Coordinate rework planning for customer inspection rework, damaged module rework, downgrade rework, and other special rework cases.
• Track rework quantity, priority, MO status, production progress, warehouse movement, and shipment readiness.
• Monitor full pallets, partial pallets, multi-label inventory, overproduction, and special stock.
• Support stock conversion, inventory consumption, and shipment planning.
• Compare SAP, MES, and WMS inventory/output data and escalate discrepancies between system records and actual stock.
• Work closely with Sales, Production, Warehouse, Material Control, Engineering, Quality, and Planning teams to close open issues and reduce execution risks.
• Maintain reports related to production status, inventory, GRD, rework progress, and order fulfillment.
• Support SOP development, planning accuracy improvement, and process improvement initiatives.
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
• 1–3 years of experience in production planning, supply chain, manufacturing coordination, inventory control, or a related function preferred.
• Solar or manufacturing industry experience is a plus.
• Experience with SAP, MES, WMS, ERP, or production planning systems preferred.
• Strong data analysis, problem identification, cross-functional communication, and follow-up skills.
• Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
• Bilingual English / Chinese communication skills preferred.
• Core competencies include production planning coordination, order fulfillment follow-up, inventory control, material readiness tracking, data analysis, risk escalation, cross-functional communication, ownership, and follow-through.
Place of Job in the Organizational Structure:
This position reports to the PMC Manager / Master Planner and works closely with Sales, Production, Warehouse, Material Control, Engineering, Quality, and Planning teams. The role is based at the Jacksonville, FL manufacturing site and serves as a key coordination point between production planning, material readiness, inventory control, and order fulfillment.
